Backend 5/5 pytest pass: GET /api/child-profiles returns list, POST creates profile with profile_id, POST /api/progress with profile_id persists scoped progress, GET /api/progress?profile_id=X correctly filters by profile, /api/progress/review accepts profile_id. All 8 cards render Lucide SVG icons (no large emoji in card body). Profile switcher with 2 seeded profiles (Eliya/Noah) shows 2 switch-child-<profile_id> buttons each with initial-circle + 'Mode {name}' + age + themes; switch-add-child link points to /app/parent; switch-parent button present. critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1878 lines — monolith still pending split (auth/admin/content/srs/ai routers). Repeatedly flagged since iter14.
AppLayout.jsx is 389 lines — switcher block (lines ~167-271) could be extracted to /components/ProfileSwitcher.jsx for clarity.
Jouer.jsx GAMES array hardcodes status='soon' for 4 games — when implementing 'letters/repeat/color/puzzle', simply flip status to 'ready' and add 'to' route. Clean and easy.

ModeEnfant.jsx: when activeChild changes, theme state is initialized once via useState but not reset if activeChild's themes no longer include current theme — minor edge case (e.g., switching from Eliya[famille,animaux] to Noah[nourriture,couleurs] while a famille tab was active could leave invalid theme until tab click). The validSlugs guard catches it on URL params but not on activeChild swap. Consider an effect: useEffect(()=>{ if(!validSlugs.includes(theme)) setTheme(validSlugs[0]); }, [activeChild?.profile_id]).
AuthContext loadChildProfiles dependency on activeChild causes re-fetch each time activeChild changes — could be optimized but not breaking.
